==
 AJAY SINGH @ AJAY KUMAR SINGH Son of Gauri Shankar Singh R/V-  Saidara, P.S- Bhabhua, Dist- Kaimur  ... ...
 Versus  1. The State of Bihar  2. Krishna Devi Wife of Ajay Singh @ Ajay Kumar Singh R/V- Saidara, P.S-  Bhabhua Dist- Kaimur  ... ...
For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Arvnendra Kumar Thakur

For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Md. Aslam Ansari  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE NAWNEET KUMAR  PANDEY  ORAL ORDER 3 19-04-2023 Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner as well as the learned counsel for the informant.

The petitioner is seeking regular bail in connection with Bhabhua P.S. Case No. 506 of 2022,
registered for the offences punishable under Sections 341, 323, 354(B), 307/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
The petitioner is husband of the informant.
As per allegation, the petitioner and other accused persons, who are relatives of the petitioner, badly assaulted the informant.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the marriage between the couple was solemnized in the year 2008.
Due to matrimonial disharmony, the victim has already Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.2847 of 2023(3) dt.19-04-2023 filed a case under Section 498A of the I.P.C.
against the petitioner and other family members, in which the petitioner has been granted bail.
She has also filed a case for maintenance under Section 125 of the Cr.P.C. and the petitioner has paid maintenance of Rs. Rs. 3,79,500/- up-till-now.

sentences.text: On the other hand, the learned counsel for the informant has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that three injuries are present on the person of the informant, which shows that accused persons have assaulted her.

He has submitted further that the accused persons including the petitioner have also denied the right of residence to the informant in her matrimonial house and a considerable amount of maintenance is still due to the petitioner and he is not paying the maintenance regularly.
The learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner shall deposit the entire due maintenance amount in the bank account of the informant in five equal monthly installments.
He has also agreed to provide residence either in the same house or by constructing another accommodation.
It is expected that the petitioner shall adhere to his words.

Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.2847 of 2023(3) dt.19-04-2023 Considering the above-mentioned facts and circumstances, let the petitioner above-named be released provisionally for a period of six months on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kaimur, Bhabhua Kaimur in connection with Bhabua P.S. Case No. 506 of 2022.

List the matter on 16.10.2023.
 (Nawneet Kumar Pandey, J)
